body:
## What to build

Allow a sorted SQLite Margin result to serve as the input to another expansion, using its public columns and row values.

At main `58356a67a79d1d2961eac6b8865d30afdb751d5c`, a two-row SQLite input with character dimension `g` and integer payload was expanded with an included-only grouping set and requested Margin order. Direct collection correctly returned the two public columns. Expanding that result again without a Grouping specification exposed private sort columns. Expanding it with a rollup instead failed with `SELECTs to the left and right of UNION ALL do not have the same number of result columns`, where four public row copies were expected.

The direct SQLite renderer included physical sort columns which its own collector removed. The expansion input relation reused that SQL through a star projection while registering only public names. Unchanged and rewritten branches therefore disagreed about their physical columns. An unsorted input result, a changed-query mutation, and explicit input materialization were successful controls. Both one-set and multi-set sorted input results reproduced it, with or without a new identifier and under all second-operation sort modes.

This is a public-schema composition defect. It does not require preservation of an earlier Margin order through later ordinary verbs. Closed #895 addressed a distinct Arrow reuse boundary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A no-grouping or included-only re-expansion exposes only its documented public columns, with original values and row cardinality.
- [ ] A rollup over a sorted one-set or multi-set SQLite Margin result collects all expected copies without compound-column mismatch.
- [ ] Cover new identifiers and none/first/last Margin order, empty inputs, direct and finite collection, and explicit result materialization.
- [ ] Retain source and declared-output type handling, public schema, materialization safety, and construction-time laziness; add no input-data read.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

comments.body: Reproduction, observed behavior, controls, environment, and investigation scope are recorded in [the dated investigation](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/89907f34da478f90625f3c10066498ec5538f2db/investigation/expand-grouping-bug-hunt-2026-10-29.md#s1-a-sorted-sqlite-result-leaked-private-columns-on-re-expansion) and PR #982. The note pins the inspected main snapshot. No package implementation is included.

title: [P2] Preserve the public SQLite schema when re-expanding sorted Margin results
